CAS — 132036-88-5 (ramosetron); 132907-72-3 (ramo- setron hydrochloride). (ramosetron) Profile Ramosetron is a 5-HT3 antagonist with general properties similar to those of ondansetron (p.1756). Ramosetron hydrochloride is given for its antiemetic properties in the management of nausea and vomiting induced by cancer chemotherapy in usual doses of 300 micrograms once daily intravenously, or 100 micrograms once daily by mouth. Ramosetron is also under investigation in the management of diarrhoea-predominant irritable bowel syn- drome.
